## 🔄 TASK CLAIMING WORKFLOW

```bash
# 1. Check available tasks
~/memory-task-marketplace.sh list high

# 2. Claim a task
export MY_CLAUDE="your-agent-id"
~/memory-task-marketplace.sh claim <task-id> $MY_CLAUDE 120

# 3. Work on task (log progress to memory)
~/memory-system.sh log "progress" $MY_CLAUDE "Working on <task-id>: <update>" "task,progress"

# 4. Complete task
~/memory-task-marketplace.sh complete <task-id> "Result: <what was done>"

# 5. Log completion
~/memory-system.sh log "completed" $MY_CLAUDE "Completed <task-id>" "task,completed"
```
